2026_02_PHI_TEN.headline: Philadelphia’s interior replacements draw Tennessee’s most disruptive defensive matchup
2026_02_PHI_TEN.paragraph1: Philadelphia enters with Landon Dickerson on injured reserve, putting its replacement interior directly against Jeffery Simmons and making pocket integrity a major concern. Jalen Carter and Cooper DeJean are available, but Jonathan Greenard remains out, so the Eagles must create pressure without their full edge group. Tennessee needs Cam Ward to avoid long-yardage situations against Vic Fangio’s coverage structure, while Philadelphia can use Jalen Hurts’ mobility and offensive balance if Simmons is prevented from consistently collapsing the middle.
2026_02_PHI_TEN.model_rationale: Philadelphia’s interior protection against Simmons and Tennessee’s ability to keep Ward in manageable situations should determine which offense can preserve its preferred rhythm and avoid drive-killing pressure.
